notes: The $10,910.88 figure is DCAD's 2026 estimate on a $490,000 taxable value with no exemptions applied. It reconciles exactly: $490,000 x 2.22671% = $10,910.88.
Texas has no California-style Proposition 13 assessment cap. Values are reappraised toward market, so a buyer's assessment may differ from the current figure.
2026 values are shown by DCAD as proposed and can change through the appraisal review process.
A buyer who occupies the home as a principal residence may be eligible to file a Texas homestead exemption, which would reduce the taxable value. Eligibility and amounts must be confirmed with DCAD.

highlights.title: Two bedrooms, two ensuite baths
highlights.body: Each bedroom has its own full bath, so there is no shared-bath compromise between the primary and the second bedroom.

highlights.title: A separate den, not a converted bedroom
highlights.body: A dedicated 9 x 10 den means a home office or studio without giving up the second bedroom.

highlights.title: Single-level, ground-floor living
highlights.body: Unit 101 is on the first floor of a three-story building, laid out on one level with no interior stairs.

highlights.title: A 28-foot open living space
highlights.body: Living, dining and kitchen run together across the main space, with windows on multiple sides.

highlights.title: Gas cooktop kitchen with a large island
highlights.body: Gas cooktop under a vented stainless hood, full stainless appliance suite, tile backsplash, and an oversized island with seating.

highlights.title: Polished concrete floors throughout
highlights.body: Durable, continuous concrete flooring runs through the living areas — no carpet seams, no refinishing.

highlights.title: Two covered underground parking spaces
highlights.body: Two assigned, covered spaces in the building's secured underground garage, plus a private covered balcony above street level.

highlights.title: Lock-and-leave ownership
highlights.body: The $457 monthly HOA covers building insurance, structural maintenance and management, so there is no roof, yard or exterior punch list.
